notes: Found by job-scout; Berlin; recruiter post, employer unnamed; LinkedIn level Mid-Senior; English docs; gaps: founding/hiring experience, production-scale backend ownership; ATS 75%
apply_hint: Apply via: https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/4481473850 (recruiter, confidential employer). Ask the recruiter for the company name, stage, funding, salary + equity range, and team size.
verdict: Solid on "build AI-native applications 0→1 end-to-end": sole developer of Kniit's agentic pipeline at an early-stage startup, reporting to the CTO; full-stack (FastAPI + React) and cloud (Azure, AWS CDK, Docker, K8s); LLMs/Agentic AI is "highly desirable" and is the core of the profile. Weaker: LinkedIn level is Mid-Senior, the role wants strong backend/system-architecture fundamentals and shipping production software as a founding engineer, plus building the wider engineering team later. Three years of experience is at the low end.
